status: Selected evidence; no measurements or host admission

claims.claim: Current RM0456 Rev7 review is unavailable.
claims.applicability: U585, U5A5 and U5G9
claims.engineering_consequence: Do not admit a U5 host probe whose behavior depends on unread current register descriptions; H01 cannot claim complete host review.
claims.open_assumption: Rev6-to-Rev7 relevant delta and current selected chapters.
claims.required_negative_case: A stale cover or HTML error body must not be accepted as the current PDF.

claims.claim: The U5G9 package table must use DS14102 Rev5, not stale Rev4 snippets.
claims.applicability: STM32U5G9ZJT6Q LQFP144 and STM32U5G9ZJJ6Q UFBGA144
claims.engineering_consequence: Keep both exact package leads visible; Safe7 generic U5G9ZJ and DK1 U5G9NJH6Q are not package substitutions.
claims.open_assumption: Exact ZJ pad/AF and supply-domain review; received marking.
claims.required_negative_case: Reject pin assignments copied from NJ/TFBGA216 or older package tables.

claims.claim: U5G9 offers materially more internal UI working memory, subject to ECC and ownership.
claims.applicability: U5G9ZJ; not every U5 family member
claims.engineering_consequence: Assess 480×480 review/recovery UI without assuming external PSRAM stores secrets. Larger RAM is not proof of trusted display ownership.
claims.open_assumption: Full SRAM banks/graphics master attribution/current RM and peak workload budget.
claims.required_negative_case: Stress UI+USB+crypto while checking that non-secret frame buffers cannot disclose or overwrite secret arenas.

claims.claim: A framebuffer budget alone can reject an unsuitable UI configuration.
claims.applicability: RGB565 buffers, no compression
claims.engineering_consequence: 240×320×2=153600 bytes (150 KiB); 480×480×2×2=921600 bytes (900 KiB). The latter exceeds U585 main SRAM before stacks/USB/crypto. Strip rendering remains a possible alternative.
claims.open_assumption: Actual stack, allocator, retained buffers, ECC, application concurrency and rendering rate.
claims.required_negative_case: Largest allowed review text/recovery input plus host flooding must remain bounded without hidden truncation.

claims.claim: S3 module variant controls available pins, rail voltage and external memory.
claims.applicability: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 lead only
claims.engineering_consequence: 8MB flash+8MB PSRAM; GPIO35–37 reserved by octal PSRAM. Use 3.0–3.6V module supply and preserve EN/strap requirements; exposed external RAM is not default secret storage.
claims.open_assumption: Exact memory die, received silicon, kit revision and regulator margins.
claims.required_negative_case: Wrong module variant, boot strap held by accessory, or battery below module operating minimum must fail safely.

claims.claim: S3 DMA descriptors and memory placement are explicit ownership work.
claims.applicability: S3 internal RAM, GDMA and selected USB controller
claims.engineering_consequence: Internal descriptor storage, transfer bounds/alignment, core/cache coherence and descriptor lifetime need static ownership. Descriptor owner bit is not a security authorization. USB OTG has its own AHB master.
claims.open_assumption: Exact USB slave/DMA path and all enabled masters; remaining permission-register subset if protection used.
claims.required_negative_case: Malformed length/stale descriptor, simultaneous core writes and peripheral reset during transfer must not reach secret memory.

claims.claim: S3 RNG strength depends on a live qualified entropy source.
claims.applicability: ESP-IDF v6.1 S3 RNG path
claims.engineering_consequence: After boot, RF or SAR entropy conditions must be maintained. esp_random returning a u32 cannot signal source loss; the Board entropy adapter must enforce S02 fallibility and prohibit silent pseudo-random fallback.
claims.open_assumption: Pinned implementation/health policy and hardware fault observability; ADC/RF ownership conflicts.
claims.required_negative_case: Disable/lose the qualified source, request during startup/sleep transition, or contend for SAR; secret operations must fail.

claims.claim: S3 boot and update authorities are finite lifecycle choices.
claims.applicability: S3 Secure Boot v2 and selected OTA configuration
claims.engineering_consequence: Separate owner firmware signing roots from Nostr identity and Bridge transport keys. Three digest slots and 16 secure-version fuse bits require an explicit owner rotation/recovery policy; ordinary app A/B safety does not cover all bootloader/data updates.
claims.open_assumption: Exact SDK build, fuse map, surviving state and bootloader-update contradiction.
claims.required_negative_case: Unsigned/old firmware, power loss during update, revocation of last usable root and rollback to incompatible state require distinct expected outcomes.
claims.closure_owner: H02; irreversible actions require concrete authorization

claims.claim: Enabling S3 release security can irreversibly alter the device.
claims.applicability: S3 owner-secured lifecycle, not development probe
claims.engineering_consequence: Start H02 with public fixtures and a non-provisioning build. A config toggle is not an authorized fuse operation. Flash encryption protects storage paths, not a compromised running privileged CPU.
claims.open_assumption: Exact key custody, flash/NVS regions, debug/download policy and recovery transition.
claims.required_negative_case: Rebuild/config mistake must not auto-provision development hardware; loss of update authority must not silently destroy recoverability.

claims.claim: S3 resets do not uniformly erase internal state.
claims.applicability: S3 reset/power states
claims.engineering_consequence: Reset type and RTC retention must be included in secret zeroization and consent invalidation. Default 2.7V brownout setting is below the module 3.0V operating minimum.
claims.open_assumption: NV-write voltage margin and complete reset/sleep driver sequence.
claims.required_negative_case: CPU reset, watchdog reset, brownout and retained sleep must invalidate pending approval and clear designated secret buffers.

claims.claim: S3 USB-OTG and USB-Serial/JTAG share the internal PHY.
claims.applicability: S3 internal PHY USB device probe
claims.engineering_consequence: Use the actual USB device path and separate debugging arrangement. USB Serial/JTAG is a debug/download surface. FS USB wake from light sleep is not supported by the reviewed stack page.
claims.open_assumption: Exact TinyUSB component commit, endpoint/FIFO/DMA and suspend policy.
claims.required_negative_case: Host reset/flood/unplug during consent and suspend/resume must neither approve nor deadlock UI; debug commands must not enter custody protocol.

claims.claim: S3 physical AES advisory is relevant to long-lived wrapping designs.
claims.applicability: AR2026-005, general-purpose AES-128 under voltage fault injection
claims.engineering_consequence: Do not transfer the vendor ephemeral/per-device-key assumption to a long-lived SE wrapping key. No complete fix is established here; XTS scope is distinct.
claims.open_assumption: Concrete threat, key usage and proposed mitigation qualification.
claims.required_negative_case: If physical fault resistance is advertised, test the exact relevant service under an appropriate independently defined campaign.

claims.claim: TrustZone does not alone establish application or physical isolation.
claims.applicability: ST M33 secure/nonsecure shared resources and exact certified services
claims.engineering_consequence: Initial SDK is one trusted image. Constant-time secret code and exact service assurance scope remain necessary; neither a TrustZone feature label nor certification of a different service closes the Board threat model.
claims.open_assumption: Any future hostile-app model needs a separate complete ownership/side-channel design.
claims.required_negative_case: A future adversarial nonsecure workload must not infer secrets through shared-resource timing.

claims.claim: SA0055 concerns a manufacturing SFI configuration, not every runtime use.
claims.applicability: U5 external-flash SFI using affected RSSe/personalization tuple
claims.engineering_consequence: Use the qualified replacement RSSe and matched personalization if this production flow is selected; do not label unrelated H573 runtime behavior affected.
claims.open_assumption: Exact factory tuple and current terms; SFI not selected in H01.
claims.required_negative_case: Wrong/old RSSe or mismatched personalization must be rejected before production secrets are introduced.

claims.claim: P4 secure boot must be bound to silicon revision and algorithm.
claims.applicability: P4 v0.x/1.x/3.0/3.1/3.2 as listed by each erratum
claims.engineering_consequence: Do not admit v3.0 ROM-764 by disabling a required secure-boot property. ECDSA_DS-836 affects v3.0–3.2 and 837 earlier revisions; vendor workaround uses RSA_DS secure boot. ROM maintenance/power errata also differ by revision.
claims.open_assumption: Actual silicon/ROM, chosen boot algorithm, SDK/esptool and maintenance procedure.
claims.required_negative_case: Invalid r/s secure-boot signature, secure-download flash access and programming/power sequence require revision-specific tests.

claims.claim: SE051 mandatory command/errata access remains unresolved.
claims.applicability: SE051C2 exact OPN/OEF/applet tuple unresolved
claims.engineering_consequence: Public headers do not establish command preconditions, policy enforcement or applicable errata. NXP applet update authority is separate from MCU owner authority; H02S/H04 remain blocked for selected-SE guarantees.
claims.open_assumption: Lawful API/errata/update/personalization access, developer redistribution and actual package/configuration.
claims.required_negative_case: Reproducible developer setup must fail visibly if required credentials, docs or update rights are unavailable.

claims.claim: Algorithm labels do not establish non-exportable Nostr services.
claims.applicability: SE051C2, standard Trust M V3, TROPIC01 reviewed versions
claims.engineering_consequence: Do not infer BIP340 from ECDSA or Nostr ECDH from generic ECC. Plan host software custody/work buffers unless exact required SE commands/policies are demonstrated; no SE is selected.
claims.open_assumption: Exact commands, curve, key import/export policy and public-vector behavior.
claims.required_negative_case: Unsupported curve/algorithm, wrong object policy and export attempt must fail with documented status.

claims.claim: PIN retry protection includes host persistent-state and reset semantics.
claims.applicability: Candidate-specific policy, not interchangeable SE API
claims.engineering_consequence: Specify enrollment/change/recovery, destructive retry state, authorization lifetime and replacement of default pairing keys. No automatic timed delay or independent dual-SE protection is inferred.
claims.open_assumption: Complete selected object/channel/counter/reset and power-cut state machines.
claims.required_negative_case: Power cut/reboot/rollback between each state change must not restore attempts or preserve authorization unintentionally.

claims.claim: The TROPIC public advisory includes T310; no qualified fix is established.

evidence.locator: affected-products p.3, mitigation pp.5–6, timeline p.10

claims.applicability: TR01-C2P-T310 Boot2.0.1/App2.0.0/SPECT1.0.0 in advisory; wider architecture scope as stated there
claims.engineering_consequence: Open documentation is useful but does not close affected asset protection. Future hardened-part forecasts are not received-qualified remediation.
claims.open_assumption: Exact intended part/threat, vendor remedy and independent qualification.
claims.required_negative_case: A newer part label or public-disclosure schedule must not be accepted as proof the intended service resists the published attack.

claims.claim: A vendor USB command bridge is not a local custody signer.

evidence.locator: single-page visually reviewed schematic; PA4/5/6/7, PB0, PA0

claims.applicability: TS1303 USB devkit/host bridge reference
claims.engineering_consequence: Host-driven bus commands and host-held protocol secrets are useful for command testing, not proof of local consent or secret isolation. MCU U535CCT6 has 256KiB flash despite inconsistent README wording.
claims.open_assumption: Received assembly/firmware and exact documented command tool.
claims.required_negative_case: Raw host commands must be unable to bypass the eventual Signer review boundary; reference bridge cannot satisfy that test.

claims.claim: Reference display and battery wiring is not generic.
claims.applicability: Safe7 RevD main schematic; firmware revC mapping unresolved
claims.engineering_consequence: Custom DSI flex, switched rails, touch/IRQ/backlight paths and LiFePO4 reference require exact module/chemistry contracts. Do not transplant a generic 4.2V charger or standard-display connector claim.
claims.open_assumption: RevD-to-firmware correspondence, excluded UI/battery assembly details and native CAD/BOM.
claims.required_negative_case: Wrong FPC contact orientation or wrong cell chemistry must be rejected before wiring.

claims.claim: Battery optionality does not remove current entitlement or power-path review.
claims.applicability: 5V USB sink and protected Li-ion optional-cell investigation
claims.engineering_consequence: BQ24074 permits absent-battery operation under input limits; BQ25628 reset/current/watchdog policy needs hardware-safe limits. A 500mA fuse or regulator capacity grants no USB current entitlement.
claims.open_assumption: Current USB-IF normative clauses, exact charger OPN/thermal/components, chemistry/protection and attach/reset default.
claims.required_negative_case: Attach before firmware, default-current source, battery absent, CE/I2C fault and watchdog reset must remain within allowed draw.

claims.claim: A single-cell 3.3V rail needs full-range regulation analysis.
claims.applicability: TPS63802 buck-boost lead versus AP2112 LDO reference
claims.engineering_consequence: LDO dropout near low cell voltage prevents assuming a stable 3.3V rail. Buck-boost current ratings depend on Vin and temperature; startup, reverse current and effective L/C matter.
claims.open_assumption: Exact load/cell voltage/temperature, startup and shutdown/backfeed measurements.
claims.required_negative_case: Low cell/high backlight load, plug/unplug and disabled-rail backdrive must not corrupt state or exceed pin limits.

claims.claim: Maker buses require explicit lifecycle ownership and voltage limits.
claims.applicability: Generic Board SDK and separate Signer firmware
claims.engineering_consequence: Expose useful SPI/I2C/UART/GPIO through a bounded API; keep SE and approval/input paths private. Default disconnect/reset must not power or clock a private device through headers. A GPIO count is not an isolation proof.
claims.open_assumption: Exact package/pad/AF/reset/power/master ownership and protected-load design.
claims.required_negative_case: Hostile accessory driving while off, stuck bus, DMA request and firmware replacement must obey the declared development/owner-secured lifecycle.
